plugins.name: atelier
plugins.description: Generative animation for Claude Code — flow fields, physarum, strange attractors, boids, reaction-diffusion, domain warping; GPU/WebGL2 GPGPU and raymarched SDFs; density-to-tone mapping, post-processing and art direction. Parameters are machine-verified, and a bundled capture script records the running result so the work gets judged by watching it. Also includes interface-motion recipes.
